newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-HUNGARY, NORWAY DRAW 1-1 IN CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HUNGARY, NORWAY DRAW 1-1 IN CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Hungary and Norway fought out a 1-1 draw in their World Cup European zone group three qualifier on Sunday.

Norway went ahead in the eighth minute when Hungarian goalkeeper Gabor Babos could ony palm out a long free kick by Henning Berg to Petter Rudi, who volleyed the rebound in between two Hungarian defenders.
Hungary came back strongly and equalised 14 minutes later when Zoltan Kovacs latched on to a delicate chip over the Norwegian defence by defender Emil Lorincz to shoot powerfully past Frode Grodaas.
The frenetic pace subsided in the second half, although Frank Strandl and Petter Rudi for Norway and Zoltan Kovacs for Hungary all went close to scoring.
The result keeps both teams in the running for World Cup qualification with Norway maintaining their four-point lead in the group and Hungary moving ahead of Switzerland into joint second place.
